name: Arakawa Mikoto
source:
Side character of episode 2
A miko born in the Arakawa family, the one with highest influence in Futagami village.
Having the duty of performing Shinto rituals, Mikoto was blessed with a special power which she would use to cleanse "infected" people. 
Regarding her power, she also believes that depriving herself of eyesight would make it become stronger. [spoiler]Becoming desperate after her mother's death, Mikoto decided to wound her eyes in hope of protecting more people in her village, which, ultimately leads to her death.[/spoiler]
